sources.topic: TP program create/copy/open/close/select, free position and instruction deletion
Position/joint getters, type/frame metadata and comment reads

implementation.store: Explicit typed logical records, bounded opaque instruction text, complete grouped positions and frame/tool metadata, comments and four writable headers
implementation.access: Root-owned monotonic handles, none/read/read-write access, symmetric reject masks, same-owner reopen and automatic terminal cleanup; pause/linked routine return retains handles
implementation.positions: Independent extended/padded joint queries, normalization to requested Cartesian representation, exact stored joint widths and retained external metadata
implementation.catalog: Explicit records join PROG_LIST/LOAD_STATUS and header attributes with activity guards, keeping attached KAREL namespace precedence
implementation.persistence: Detached typed JSON values, limits and selection; handles, owners, locks and sequence omitted

portable_choices.names: Case-insensitive 1..36 letter-starting ASCII identifiers without paths/extensions
portable_choices.bounds: Groups 1..32, positions 1..32767, programs 1..4096, 1024 open handles; default group 1, position limit 32767 and program limit 256
portable_choices.metadata: POSITION type 1, XYZWPR 2, XYZWPREXT 6 and JOINTPOS 9; axis output is 0/3/joint width; new frame/tool IDs zero, replacement preserves IDs
portable_choices.copy: Closed source/destination, selected-target guard, detached values and own headers, explicit overwrite
portable_choices.instructions: One-based deletion of opaque ASCII lines without TP syntax or motion-reference analysis
portable_choices.status: 0 success; 1 missing; 2 invalid; 3 handle/access; 4 busy/reject/selected; 5 exists; 6 full; 7 successful comment truncation; 8 small comment output; 17038 absent position
portable_choices.failed_getters: Set status then raise without replacing assignment target, matching offline position-register getter behavior
